precision.expert_weights: exact sparse ternary codes with FP32 scales
precision.expert_activations: existing single-component NVFP4; approximate vs BF16
precision.head: BF16 operands with FP32 accumulation/output

paired-gdn-bmm-sweep.scope: Trained GDN2 output projections; synthetic strided BF16 inputs

rejected.larger_expert_tiles: Exact but slower on real first-layer routed inputs.
rejected.paired_gdn_bmm: Changes BF16 rounding and gives negligible gain.
rejected.late_value_loads: Exact quality checks passed, but component gains gave under 0.5% serving gain; not promoted.
rejected.router256: Faster by ~1.4%, but failed model-level numerical gate; not promoted. Gate errors from one-layer synthetic checks understated trajectory sensitivity.

router_numerical_screen.scope: Greedy trajectories used only as a numerical screen. Throughput benchmarking uses stochastic sampling. Not a broad quality evaluation.
router_numerical_screen.logprob_comparison_note: After token divergence, full-trajectory LP differences compare different contexts and do not estimate quality loss.

router_experimental_precision: FP32 weights/outputs with split-K TF32x3 products; changes numerical reduction and must not be called bit-exact. Disabled in recommended config.
